from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single record of net profit extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The label of the financial metric reported (e.g. '归属于母公司股东的净利润')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the reported profit; losses should be negative")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period (e.g. '2024 Q1')")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency of the reported amount (e.g. 'CNY')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    profit_records: list[ProfitRecord]
